english.title: Scheme operator fail to make application before 30th November of year preceding commencement of scheme

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a scheme who was required by regulation 25 of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 to register the scheme members of that scheme, failed, for the purpose of registering scheme members for a

(A)_[compliance period,]_
(B)_[part of a compliance period,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26(1), 90(3) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
